checklist.notes: The set practises the live/leave contrast through comprehension, clarification, speaking, and writing tied to basic participation.
The repair phrases and constrained outputs give usable support for clarifying a misheard word.
Recognition and production modes are both present, though the first open speaking task appears before the more controlled construction and choice tasks.
Task outcomes and limits are explicit; the transcript can serve as an offline read-aloud script.
Short utterances, a two-word contrast, and two-turn caps keep demands manageable for A1.1.
Focused vowel discrimination and explicit communication repair are useful for Vietnamese learners, without claiming all learners share one pronunciation issue.
Five compact tasks with tightly bounded spoken and written output are reasonable.

methods: Reviewed the exercise set and audit against the declared original project-authored policy and external-payload/media declarations.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: No Internet-wide copyright or plagiarism search was performed; this review checked only the declared original project-authored policy and supplied artifact evidence.

findings.description: The medium open speaking task precedes the controlled clarification-question construction and meaning-choice scaffolds.
findings.recommendation: Place controlled recognition and construction before the open speaking response in a future sequence.

findings.description: The listening item depends on someone reading the visible script aloud; without that delivery, orthography reveals live and does not test vowel discrimination.
findings.recommendation: Make the read-aloud procedure explicit or hide the transcript from the learner during first listening.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence, not human review or release approval.
The review covers the supplied immutable exercise set and automated audit; it does not report an Internet-wide originality search.
